timeline.summary: Control Print executed an IP Assignment Agreement to acquire patents and IPRs from its step-down subsidiary CP Italy S.R.L. for Euros 2.86 Million.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹139.87 Cr (+14.6% YoY), net profit ₹11.19 Cr (-83.2% YoY).
Control Print filed its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation showing standalone revenue of ₹445.95 Cr and declared a final dividend of ₹6 per share.

Control Print Limited’s **Murli Manohar Thanvi** conducts Q4FY2026 Investors Conference Call via Kaptify Consulting on May 21, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST; recording available at [controlprint.com/investors](https://controlprint.com/investors/investor-presentation/).
Control Print hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call discussing subsidiary losses and track-and-trace progress.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹144.22 Cr (+28.8% YoY), net profit ₹13.13 Cr (-29.4% YoY).
Control Print released its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting in consolidated revenue at ₹144.22 Cr.
Control Print Limited conducted an analyst/investor conference call on October 29, 2026 at 02:00 PM IST for Q2Y2027, audio recorded and posted on its website.
